result:
Everything checks out.

## Summary

**Root cause:** `slugify` in `lib/slugify.js` replaced every non-alphanumeric character with its own `-` (`.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')`), so runs of separators became runs of dashes, and leading/trailing separators left dangling dashes.

**Fix:** collapse each run of non-alphanumeric characters into a single `-`, then trim any leading/trailing dash:
```js
String(input).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
```

**Verification:**
- Wrote failing regression tests first (collapsing runs, trimming edges, empty string, separator-only string) — confirmed they failed against the old code (`npm test` showed 3 failures).
- Applied the fix; all 8 tests pass.
- Manually confirmed `slugify('Hello,  World!')` → `'hello-world'`, and `slugify('')`, `slugify('!!!')` → `''`.
- Confirmed `lib/truncate.js` was never touched (`git diff` empty on that file).

**Commit hygiene:** The repo had unrelated uncommitted edits (a CHANGELOG "Ideas" section, `scratch/`). I staged only the fix's hunks (via a targeted CHANGELOG rewrite + `git add`, then restored the full working-tree file) so the commit (`32ce523`) contains just `lib/slugify.js`, `test/strutil.test.js`, and my "Unreleased" CHANGELOG line — the "Ideas" edit and `scratch/` remain exactly as they were, still uncommitted.
